attributes.name: pagination_control_shape
attributes.definition: The shape of the individual pagination or paging controls (page indicators, chips, buttons).

values.definition: Page items are round circles or circular numbered chips.
Controls are outlined buttons rather than numbered indicators.

attributes.name: pagination_mechanism
attributes.definition: How the page or paging navigation is presented to the user.

values.definition: Numbered items letting the user see and jump to specific pages.
Numbered pagination is replaced by labeled action buttons such as 'See more' or 'Random'.

attributes.name: active_page_indicator_style
attributes.definition: How the currently active page or slide is marked in pagination.

values.definition: Active item is shown with a solid fill.
Active item is marked by outline or underline.
No active state is indicated or no pagination.
